primaryWitnesses.text: These are the children of Dishon: Hemdan, Eshban, Ithran, and Cheran.
The son of Anah: Dishon. The sons of Dishon: Hamran, Eshban, Ithran, and Cheran.

comparison: Same named parent Dishon and same following three children Eshban/Ithran/Cheran; differing first child Hemdan versus Hamran. This supports investigating an established spelling/witness variant rather than treating different strings as conclusive different identity.

historicalOriginalSource.section: International Standard Bible Encyclopedia, lines31-34; exclude modern Topical Encyclopedia introduction
historicalOriginalSource.paraphrase: The historical entry explicitly relates Genesis Hemdan to Chronicles Hamran, notes KJV Amram and RV Hamran, and interprets this as a transmission difference. Its textual-emendation certainty need not be adopted as fact.

recommendation: Independent reviewer should assess source-supported variant identity; a cautious Hemdan/Hamran profile at1CH1:41 may be possible with exact WEB display and transparent variant note. Do not fabricate a new ID or a Wikipedia link.
